effect.name: Tint
effect.description: Pushes the sprite toward a flat colour without touching its alpha. The everyday one: team colours, poison green, frozen blue, a dimmed-out menu item.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Colour
parameter.description: The colour to tint toward. Fusion stores colours as BGR, the build script prints the RGB reading in shaders/REFERENCE.md.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: 0 leaves the sprite alone, 1 replaces its colour completely.

parameter.name: Keep Shading
parameter.description: On, the tint keeps the sprite's own light and shade. Off, it flattens to one colour.
